notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 (Community Feedback Update)
notes.content:
[b]New Feature - Camera Lock System
[/b]

[b]Lock Your View:[/b] Press the L key to lock the camera in its current position, giving you more control over exploratio angles.
[b]Unlock with Ease:[/b] Simply right-click to unlock the camera and resume free movement.

[u][b]Tutorial Update[/b][/u]
The tutorial has been updated to explain the Camera Lock System, ensuring new and returning players can make the most of this feature.

[b]Improvements Based on Player Feedback
[/b]
Added the Camera Lock Feature, inspired by feedback from Reddit user [i]aceandduce[/i]. Thank you for the great suggestion!

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

Fixed minor visual glitches when transitioning between locked and unlocked camera states.
Adjusted camera smoothing for a more polished and responsive feel.

[u][b]Dev Note[/b][/u]
As a solo developer, your feedback means the world to me! Keep sharing your thoughts, and together we’ll make Eternal Trails even better.

notes.title: Major Update! 🌟 HD graphics, better cameras, dismount and explore + more!
notes.content:
I'm excited to share a massive update to Eternal Trails! This update marks a significant amount of time worked on the game, enhancing nearly every element of the game and bringing new features to make your journey even more immersive. Here’s what’s new:


[u][b]What’s New?[/b][/u]

🎨 [b]Stunning HD Graphics[/b]
No more pixelation! The game now features high-definition textures that make every step of your journey look spectacular.

🌅 [b]Dynamic Shadows[/b]
Enjoy new shadows for the terrain, horse, and rider, adding depth and realism to the world.

🐎 [b]Enhanced Horse Models & Animations[/b]
Your horse has been completely reworked with improved models and animations, creating smoother and more lifelike movement.

🚶[b] Dismount and Explore[/b]
For the first time, you can dismount your horse and explore the trails on foot. Take a closer look at the serene beauty around you.

👀[b] Free-Look Camera[/b]
While riding, you can now freely look around, taking in the stunning horizons and landscapes from every angle.

📖[b] Brand-New Tutorial[/b]
Getting started is easier than ever with a new and improved tutorial designed to guide you through the journey.

🔧 [b]UI Scaling Improvements[/b]
The UI scaling has been refined to look great and function smoothly across all resolutions.

[b]One of the Last Big Updates[/b]
This update is one of the final steps in bringing my vision for Eternal Trails to life. As a solo developer, your support has meant the world to me, and I hope you enjoy these new features as much as I enjoyed creating them.
